description: This script, start-wrapper.cjs, is responsible for detecting whether the environment is running in Continuous Integration (CI) or local development, sanitizing environment variables, and then starting either a static build/serve process or a development server accordingly. It acts as a wrapper to manage startup behaviors based on environment conditions, improving stability and resource usage during CI and local runs.

methods.name: isCI
methods.description: Detects if the current environment is a CI environment by checking environment variables such as CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS, GITLAB_CI.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a given command with arguments using spawnSync, inheriting stdio, and exits the process with the command's exit code.
